sources.title: local-llm-guide/04-advanced-usage/gguf-modelfile.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: GGUF (GPT-Generated Unified Format) is the standard file format for running LLMs locally. Think of it as the .mp3 of AI models: Compressed — 70-85% smaller than the original float16 weights Fast — optimized for CPU and GPU inference Portable — one file contains the entire model Metadata-rich — includes tokenizer, chat template, and model config Every ollama pull downloads a GGUF file ...
